title: The Projects Window Finally Opens From Where You Clicked | vitalii.no
description:
How the Projects modal went from a disconnected centered box to a window that expands from the exact tile you clicked.

The Projects modal used to pop up as a fixed-size box centered on the screen, with no visual link to the grid tile the user actually clicked — even though the Services section on the same site already had a nicer expanding-window effect that Projects never got.

The grid component now measures the clicked tile's position and size on open, and re-measures it on window resize while the modal stays open. The Projects modal applies that exact rectangle as its own position and size, replacing the old fixed centered layout. The detail view was also split into a fixed cover image on one side and a write-up plus feature list that scroll independently on the other, built with Radix UI.

Opening the Projects window now visually expands from the exact grid tile it was opened from, matching the Services window's behavior, and the detail view keeps the cover image fixed while the write-up and feature list scroll independently.
